abstract.para: Add additional software to install, such as the &kvm; hypervisor or the &cockpit; system management service.
Select the &sap; software patterns needed for your environment. You can also add additional software to install such as the &kvm; hypervisor or the &cockpit; system management service.

textobject.phrase: Screenshot of the &agama; installer for &productname; &productnumber; showing the software selection page. It features panels for selecting a desktop environment and additional software package patterns along with the required disk space for the selection.

note.title: Trust the GPG key for the Package Hub repository
note.para: If you select the Package Hub add-on and see a popup, trust the GPG key for that repository.

section.title: Selecting a desktop
section.para: Select a desktop environment to get a graphical interface. &productname; ships with the &gnome; desktop.

section.title: Selecting additional software patterns
section.para: Patterns are curated sets of packages for common use cases and features to extend the system. The default installation includes Kernel dump tooling and &selnx; support.The default installation includes &selnx; support. To remove or install additional patterns, click Change patterns.

section.title: Selecting &sap; patterns
section.para: After clicking Change patterns from the software selection page, you can select the &sap; patterns required for your installation. They are located under the SAP Support section.

textobject.phrase: Screenshot of the &agama; installer for &productname; &productnumber; showing the &sap; Support software selection tab. It features different selectable patterns, including ones for &hana;, &netweaver; and &s4h;.
